fdt.note: Blob built by make_fdt.py (no dtc). Header: magic=0xd00dfeed version=17. Root node: #address-cells=1, #size-cells=1. Child: memory@40000000 { device_type='memory'; reg=<0x40000000 0x8000000> }.

notes: FDT sample. Minimal hand-crafted FDT blob embedded as a C byte array in .rodata of image.elf. The Hexana heuristic scans for magic 0xd00dfeed anywhere in the ELF binary — it will find the blob at file offset 0x10004. Rebuild: python3 make_fdt.py (regenerates image.elf and fdt-offset.txt from scratch).
